rulings.ruling: Ruling: finding; i8582 p. 10, Part IV, Caution: "Married individuals who file separate returns and lived with their spouses at any time during the tax year don’t qualify under the active participation rule and must use Part V instead of Part IV." This case (MFS, lived together late in the year) is classified in Part IV by rental.part4 = rental.active, so the project computes line 1b -\$213.20 and line 2b \$0; the hand-work puts the loss in Part V (line 2b -\$213.20). BUG-0933. Severity high.
